svg.title: Circular economy effects on European material-sector emissions

cc:Work.dc:title: Circular economy effects on European material-sector emissions
cc:Work.dc:description: EU-only CE effects on combined European cement, iron-and-steel and aluminium emissions in 2050, with NDC on the left and NDC+LTT on the right. Panels a,b retain paired OMNIA-ENGAGE solid bars on the left and GCAM hatched bars on the right. Each bar is 100 × (sum of three-sector CE emissions − sum of three-sector no-CE emissions) / sum of three-sector no-CE emissions, within the same model, pathway, geography and year. Sector percentages are not averaged. Other industry is excluded from numerator and denominator. OMNIA sums its three reported Emissions|GHG|Industry sector children in MtCO2e/yr. GCAM sums reported CO2 in Mt CO2/yr from Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Industry|Non-Metallic Minerals and Emissions|CO2|Industrial Processes|Non-Metallic Minerals|Cement for cement, Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Industry|Iron and Steel, and Emissions|CO2|Energy|Demand|Industry|Non-Ferrous Metals|Aluminum. The non-metallic-minerals energy category is assigned to cement: its final-energy parent equals the cement child throughout the supplied workbook. Overlapping cement-process and non-ferrous parents are not added. No additional steel/aluminium process-CO2 child or complete sector Kyoto/GHG inventory is supplied. This therefore compares OMNIA sector GHG responses with GCAM's reported sector CO2 responses; gas coverage, GWP conventions and process boundaries remain source-defined. Scales match across climate columns. Reported negative emissions are retained, and carbon capture is not subtracted again. NDC+LTT aluminium GHG is blank in all three OMNIA EU regions for no CE and both CE cases in 2050; the configured provisional zero treatment is retained and flagged, without establishing physical zero emissions. All-industry responses and sector contributions remain unplotted CSV context with Plotted=False. Source quantities, signed changes, reference totals, variables, units, coefficients, missing treatments and regions accompany the CSVs. Only medium/high EU-only CE enters. OMNIA sums EUE, EUM and EUW; GCAM selects EU-27 once. These boundaries differ slightly. No CE is zero by construction, which does not establish absolute-level alignment or harmonise the source inventories.
